heme_involvement_pattern.staging_system: Risk-stratified by age, WBC at presentation, cytogenetics/molecular, response to induction (MRD), CNS status. No TNM.

biomarkers.name: B-cell immunophenotype (CD19, CD22, CD79a, CD10, TdT)
biomarkers.clinical_use: CD19/22 also predictive: blinatumomab (CD19), inotuzumab (CD22), CD19 CAR-T (tisagenlecleucel, brexucabtagene)

biomarkers.name: Cytogenetics
biomarkers.clinical_use: Favourable: high hyperdiploidy (51-65 chr), t(12;21)/ETV6-RUNX1. Adverse: hypodiploidy (<44), t(9;22)/BCR-ABL1, KMT2A rearrangement (esp. infants), iAMP21, TCF3-HLF

biomarkers.name: MRD (flow cytometry, NGS, IgH-TCR clonality)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Most powerful prognostic factor in ALL. MRD-positive: intensification, blinatumomab, or transplant. Sensitivity typically 10^-4 to 10^-6

biomarkers.name: TCF3-PBX1 t(1;19)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defines a recurrent B-ALL subtype; prognosis improved with contemporary therapy

biomarkers.name: CRLF2 rearrangement / overexpression
biomarkers.prevalence: ~5-15%; enriched in Ph-like ALL and Down syndrome-associated ALL
biomarkers.clinical_use: Often associated with JAK-STAT pathway lesions; may support ABL/JAK-pathway directed evaluation in Ph-like ALL

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Small to medium blasts with scant cytoplasm, high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli (L1 morphology historically); larger blasts with prominent nucleoli (L2)
variants: FAB L3 (Burkitt-like — now classified as mature B-cell / Burkitt)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; molecular / immunophenotypic risk stratification drives management

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Distinctive immunotherapy paradigm — CD19-directed therapies (blinatumomab, tisagenlecleucel CAR-T) transformed outcomes; sanctuary sites (CNS) require dose-adjusted/site-directed therapy
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Marrow infiltration with displacement of normal haematopoiesis; extramedullary infiltration of lymph nodes, spleen, liver, testis (sanctuary)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: B-cell precursors (pro-B, pre-B) arrested at early B-cell developmental stage
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — lymphoid (bone marrow B-cell developmental hierarchy)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: B-cell precursor differentiation (CD19+, CD20 variable, CD10+, CD22+, CD79a+, TdT+) with maturation arrest at pro-B or pre-B stage; genetic subtypes drive arrest at specific developmental stages
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Distinct genetic subtypes arrest at different maturation stages: BCR-ABL1, KMT2Ar, ETV6-RUNX1 (paediatric), TCF3-PBX1, TCF3-HLF (very aggressive); some cases show lineage switching to AML under CD19-directed therapy pressure (rare but documented)
